tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor dbang chog ba ku la'i kha 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes dga' bde'i dpal// lhun gyis grub pa 'dzin skyong dkyil 'khor du// gdul bya sku bzhir smin cing grol byed pa'i// bla ma dkyil 'khor gtso bo gtsug tu mchod// 'phags bod grub dbang gzhung gi ba ku la// thun mong blo yi nyi mas phye dka' ba// dpyad gsum rigs pa'i mtshar sdug 'gram chang gis// yid ches 'dab ma stong du 'grol lo kyai// gsang chen spyod pa spyi 'gros lam zhugs nas// khyad par phra zhib ma nor 'phrang brgyud de// blo gros goms pas gzhung don rin chen gling*// bgrod pa 'di la don gnyer dga' ba byos// de'ang dkyil 'khor 'dir slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur bar byed pa'i thog mar slob dpon gyi 'brel pa brtag par bya ste/ bla ma mtshan nyid bzang ldan pa// brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan// bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med// sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor shes pas// legs par brtags pa'i slob ma'i phyir// dkyil 'khor bri bas las bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ de yang slob ma blo chen po// shin tu dad pa'i sems dang ldan// 'dod byed dbang po dul ba dang*// chags dang chags bral rnam par spangs// sems can don la shin tu brtson// gti mug zhe sdang phrag dog spangs// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis rlobs// de rnams la ni de nyid bshad// slob ma de ni yongs su bzung*// zhes pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su yo byad rnams legs par tshogs shing rgyud las gsungs pa'i tshul bzhin du bsnyen pa rab 'bring gsum gang yang rung ba sngon du song bas/ maṇḍal legs par byas la ba byung dang dri zhim po'i chu dang bdud rtsis byugs nas lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i me tog tshom bu bkod/

dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs par bskyed cing sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ dbang bskur te mchod bstod byas nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la dgongs// khyed rnams mchod pa'i phyir dang ni// slob ma rnams la phan pa'i phyir// sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i// dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar 'tshal// bdag la byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab nas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o// de nas maṇḍal gyi dbus su me tog gi tshom bu bkod de/ lag pa sa la brdabs pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo sogs dang*/ skyob pa sangs rgyas nas gnang ba byin nas sa la thim pa'i bar 'og sta gon skabs ltar brjod/ de nas phyogs skyong ba rnams la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas bkug la/ mtshan sngags de nyid la/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam lngas bsngos la/ sa phyogs gnas pa'i lha dang klu// gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin// gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan pa// rdo rje spyan dang snyan mnga' ba// bdag ming che ge zhes bgyi bas// bde gshegs rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// dge ba'i sa phyogs 'di nyid du// dkyil 'khor dam pa cher 'byung ba// sangs rgyas thod pa rgyud rgyal gyi// dkyil 'khor chen po'i las byed pa// khyed cag bar chad ma byed par// dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod// ces dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir sa'i phyogs 'dir sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/

'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ srung ma khyed rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod pa ni sa blang ba'i cho ga'o// de nas rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bdud rtsi'i chus gtor zhing*/ oṃ hūm̐ dhrī hūm̐ kham̐ a hūm̐ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya a tiṣṭha ya/ zhes brjod pas sa gzhi stong par bsams nas 'byung po la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ yang dkar gtor gcig sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas bkug la/ oṃ he ru ka badzra sa ma ya dhri/ sarba duṣṭan sa ma ya mu tra pra pañtsa ka hūm̐/ ru lu ru lu bhyo hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes pas byin la/ dpal ldan bla ma sogs nas/ 'tshal na zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin gyi mthar/ 'byung po'i tshogs khyed rnams kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsal zhing dge ba'i bar chad ma byed par gzhan du dengs shig sarba bhū ta gatstsha/ ces brjod de/ slar yang lag pa sa la bzhag nas/ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod pas sa gzhi nam mkha' ltar dag par dmigs shing*/ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ oṃ me di ni badzri bha wa bandha hūm̐ zhes brjod pa ni sa sbyang ba'i cho ga'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste bsnyen pa ltar lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms la/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i grogs kyis mchod pa dang bstod pas mnyes par byas nas/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni// sdig pa ma lus zad byed pa'i// sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// mgon po chen pos bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas langs te 'gro ba rnams la snying rjes bltas nas mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi ma zla bar bskyed cing mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas/

rkang mthil gnyis su a las sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar bar bsam zhing rdo rje'i lta bas g.yas dang g.yon du bskor bas/ khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis bgegs bsal zhing rdo rje'i 'gros kyi rdo rje'i rwa gur bsam ste/ 'gying ba dang bcas pas dbang ldan du song nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu'i sgra dang bcas pas/ nyon cig bgegs tshogs ma lus kun// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// gnod par gyur pa'i bgegs tshogs rnams// sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor gtso// bde chen ye shes las byung ba'i// nga ni he ru ka dpal dngos// bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor byed// gal te bka' las 'das gyur na// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// 'jigs par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// de bas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// zhes pas bka' bsgos nas/ g.yas skor du lan gsum bgrod pas rkang pa'i mthil nas me lta bu'i 'od zer byung nas bgegs rnams bsregs par bsam/ de nas rol mo dang bcas pa'i gom stabs kyis g.yas brkyangs pa la sogs pa'i rkang stabs brgyad dang*/ rkang pa bskyed dang lag pa bskyed// smin ma 'degs dang rab dgas 'brangs// cung zad ngo tsha'i zur mig dang*// brla rgyas lta na 'dud pa dang*// mig yangs gar ni byed 'gyur zhing*// kha yi padma'i 'dzum dang bcas// cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang*// kunda ltar dkar so yi 'phreng*// zhes pa'i lta stangs dang gar gyis bgegs rnams bskrad par bya'o// de nas seng ldeng la sogs pa las byas pa'i phur bu lnga/ hūm̐ las stod khro bo smad rdo rje rtse gcig par bskyed cing*/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣṭan phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la ya badzra dha ro a dzñā pa ya ti kā ya wāktsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa'i sngags dang bcas pas gdab cing rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa bar bsam pa ni sa'i cho ga ste rdul tshon la brten pa'i phyogs so// de nas rdul tshon dang ras bris gnyis ka ltar ram/

rdul tshon ltar na/ sa chog byas pa'i sa gzhi dang*/ ras bris yin na gzhi gtsang ma'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar maṇḍal dris byugs pa la lha nyer lnga'i tshom bu bkod pa zhal lhor phyogs pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu me long la sa lha'i tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa dang gtor ma dang*/ sa lha la'ang nyer spyod dang gtor ma logs su bsham/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad so shing khyor chu srung skud ku sha slob mar nyer spyod rnams dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du'ang rdo rje dril bu nang mchod dang*/ bum pa nang chu dang rdzas kyis gang ba gnyis kyi rnam rgyal la dung chos gzungs rdor bcas pa rnams phyag len bzhin bshams la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gcig kyang sbyangs te rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ lag pa g.yon g.yas gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes dang ha ho hrīḥlan gsum brjod/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang phaiṃ badzra ā ralli sogs kyis spyan drangs/ rdo rje thal mo kha phyes la/ oṃ kha kha sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'bru gsum brjod cing nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha'i tshogs rnams sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/

sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhugs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob bar gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang stong grogs mdzod cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la brkyangs te/ badzra muḥ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol la/ oṃ sum bha sogs brjod do// gnas yo bsang sbyangs sngar bzhin/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hūm̐ bdun zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil sogs nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs dang*/ sna tshogs rol mo byas te ghaṇḍe ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pas byin dbab bo// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas te/ dkyil 'khor bsdus nas rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis gnas pas/ de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa ni/ rang gi srin lag g.yas pa'i rtsa bar haṃ yig 'bar ba bsams la/ srin lag sa la bsnun te haṃ gsum brjod pas/ sa g.yos pa'i rkyen gyis tshom bu'i steng du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo rab tu zhi ba rin po che'i rgyan can gser gyi bum pa 'dzin cing*/

rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis las ci bgyi bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes gsung bzhin par gyur zhes brjod/ mchod pa dngos su bshams na/ bsang sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon sogs nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ zhes dang*/ arghaṃ sogs kyis byin gyis brlab/ ma bshams na mi dgos/ oṃ pṛ thi wī di wī sogs kyis mchod/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs/ 'bru gsum brjod de/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum dang*/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gi bdud sde las// rgyal bar bya ste dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sogs spyi ltar las/ dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam/ oṃ pṛ thi wī di wī arghaṃ sogs chu gnyis kyis mchod/ lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pas sa la reg ste/ badzra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid du thim zhes brjod/ de nas lha sta gon ni dri zhim po'i chu bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pas lha'i gnas su thig le byas pa la/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i sngags ni/ yab yum gyi snying po dang*/ nye snying dang*/ 'khor nyer lnga la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan re brjod/ dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma sogs nas/

gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i nang du mngon byang lnga las gtso bo 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa dang*/ zhu ba glus bskul mi dgos pa ma gtogs sgrub thabs ltar lha nyi shu rtsa lngar bskyed nas go bgo ba dang ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya/ dbang bskur ba nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbur brgyan pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ mchod pa rnams bdud rtsis gtor te bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hūm̐ bdun zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bskyed la/ rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs te/ thog mar oṃ buddha ka pā li maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha sogs spro na sgrub thabs kyi dbu nas 'byung ba'i sngags mchod bsdus pa sngon du btang nas/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ buddha ka pā li maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad gzhan 'dra ba la/ rkang pa gnyis pa'i mchod yon gyi tshab tu zhabs bsil dang*/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su pā dyaṃ bcug la zhabs bsil dbul/ de bzhin du me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams la/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ dī paṃ/ gandhe/ nai wi tye'i bar tshigs bcad dang 'don pa kha bsgyur/ ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta la sogs pa brjod cing rol chen rnams kyis mchod/ na bza'i mchod pa ni/ ras zung bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i na bza' srab pa/ 'jam pa yang ba zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par bskyed la/

srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ buddha ka pā li maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra wast+ra ya hūm̐/ zhes pas phyi mchod dang*/ nang gi mchod pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod la/ g.yon du lan gsum bskor la dbus nas blangs te/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par mos la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid kyi mtshan nas brjod de oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de nas/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dzñā na ḍā ki nī ye/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ dpal sa ra ha pa/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ grub chen sha ba ri dbang phyug mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros/ rgya rnal 'byor pa/ ro mnyam rdo rje/ yon tan grags/ khams pa sa phug pa shākya rdo rje/ gnyal pa jo sras chos grags/ khams chen rgan mo lhas pa/ bla ma bsod nams 'phel/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal ba/ rin po che grags pa tshul khrims/ bla ma byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ 'khor lo'i mgon po ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub pa ste brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'di'i snying po dang nye snying gnyis kyi mthar/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ de nas mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su bdud rtsis thig le byas la/ 'bru gsum brjod pas lus kyi lha rnams tshim par bsam/ skabs 'dir gtor ma la bar phud bran la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mgon po dang*/ oṃ shrī dharmā pā la tsa turmu kha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gdong bzhi pa la sogs pa sgos kyi chos skyong rnams la dbul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshando dang nye ba'i tshando/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/

'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam gyi lhar bsams la/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul zhing de ltar bsam mo// bdag gi lce la bdud rtsi bzhag ste lus dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad dgyes par bsams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badzra sra bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ spyi bor nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin gyis rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gis mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod la se gol brdab/ yang phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu ā kā sha sa manta māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri sho dha ye/ maṇḍa le ma ma pra ṇi dhi puṇya dzñā na ba le na/

sarba ta thā ga ta ba lendha bandha swa sthā na ba le na tsa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod de phyag rgya bkrol te se gol lan gnyis brdab par bya'o// bstod pa ni/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje glu'i bstod pas mnyes par byas nas/ pus mo btsugs lag tu me tog thogs te/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal// sna tshogs bde mar yang dag ldan// phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma rnams la phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te// kun gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab ste/ snyan gsan dbab bo// de nas gser la sogs pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lha grangs dang mthun pa'am/ yang bum pa gnyis byi dor legs par byas te mgul chings dang kha rgyan gyis mdzes par byas pa'i nang du chu dang 'o ma dang chang dang bcas pas bkang ste/ rin chen lnga/ 'bru lnga/ sman lnga/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams bcug la bsang ba dang sbyang ba byas te/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa rnams sam gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba zhabs zhum pa sogs spyi ltar bskyed pa'i rang rang gi bum par lhar bskyed pa'am/ yang na rnam rgyal gyi bum par rang rang gi gnas su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan nyi shu rtsa lnga/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ā li kā li sogs mngon byang las gtso bo yab yum sogs lha nyi shu rtsa lnga legs par bskyed/ las thams cad pa'i bum par padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa sogs cho ga gsum gyi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang gu sogs kye rdor ltar bskyed/

dbang bskur ba'i bar bskyed pa sogs nas/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgras bstod/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ bdag gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ gtso bo la snying po/ gzhan rnams la nye ba'i snying po/ las thams cad pa la oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'ang nyer gcig sogs bzlas mthar/ mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol gdab dang*/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa/ ma 'byor pa sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul nas lha rnams 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i bar spyi ltar bya ba ni bum pa sta gon no// de nas sngar bshad pa'i slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa khrus byas gos dmar po gyon pas maṇḍal phul te snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas gral la 'khod pa la/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa yang theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa rnams ris su bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis las 'dir/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni// de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*// yang dag grub pa chen po dang*// sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste// chen po 'di dag dang ldan pas// theg pa chen po khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs pa'i khyad chos bdun gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa theg pa chen po yin/

theg pa chen po la'ang rgyu'i theg pa dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis las khyad par du 'phags pa 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa ste/ slob dpon chen po kṛ pi ṭa ka ma la shī las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon pos dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes khyad chos bzhi'i khyad par du 'phags pa sngags kyi theg pa yin/ sngags kyi theg pa de la dbye ba mang du yod pa las/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa yab sras rnams kyis rdo rje gur gyi rgyud la brten nas rgyud sde bzhir bzhed pa dang*/ rje 'gos kyis ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi rgyud la brten nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i skabs su rgyud sde lngar bzhed pa ni rang rang gi rgyud la brten nas skabs rer rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa yin la/ de bzhin du/ 'dir yang rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yis// sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa// de dang de la dga' ba yi// zhes gsungs pa la brten nas mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ gsang ba'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde sgo drug tu bzhed pa las/ de'i dang po rtog pa'i rgyud ni bya rgyud kyi nang tshan las tshogs gtso bor ston pa rnams so// bya ba'i rgyud ni bdag nyid tha mal du gnas nas/ mdun du ras bris la ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la/ dka' thub dang gtsang sbra sogs kyi sgo nas dngos grub sgrub pa ste/ legs grub dang dpung bzang la sogs pa'o// spyod pa'i rgyud ni bdag nyid kyang lhar bskyed/ mdun du ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ bdag la mi bstim par grogs po lta bu'i sgo nas dngos grub sgrub pa ste rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa'o// rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni bdag nyid kyang lhar bskyed/

de la ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug byas nas phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab ste cho ga zin nas ye shes pa gshegs rang dam tshig pa rkyang pa'i nga rgyal du gnas pa'i sgo nas dngos grub sgrub pa ste de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa'o// rnal 'byor gsang ba'i rgyud la/ rnal 'byor chen po pha'i rgyud dang*/ ma'i rgyud gnyis su yod de/ dang po ni gsang ba 'dus pa sogs pha rgyud sde gsum mo// gnyis pa ma rgyud la ni/ rgyud sde sgo drug tu yod par bshad pa'i dang po he ru ka'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ kye rdor gyi rgyud rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa dang*/ ma hā mā yā la sogs pa rnams yin la/ rgyud sde bzhir 'byed pa'i tshe gsang mtha'i rgyud rnams kyang 'di'i khongs su gtogs te/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud ni/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa le'u 'bum pa dang*/ 'bring po shlau ka 'bum pa/ rtsa rgyud bsdus pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa dang*/ de dag gi bshad rgyud he ru ka mngon 'byung*/ rdo rje phag mo/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ saṃ pu ṭa/ nges brjod bla ma rnams yin la/ 'khor lo bde mchog gsang mtha' ba'i skabs 'dir bshad rgyud lnga po der nges pa yin te/ slob dpon skar rgyal zla ba'i 'grel par/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang*// kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste// bshad rgyud rnam pa lngar 'dod do// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gnyis pa rnam snang gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ mi g.yo bla med kyi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud dang*/ de'i bshad rgyud mant+ra aṃ pa ste thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud rnams so// gsum pa rin 'byung gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud de/ 'di la 'phreng bar/ rdo rje bdud rtsi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dngos su bshad cing*/ rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi khro bo ste gsum du yod par rgyud las gsungs so// bzhi pa 'od dpag med kyi rigs kyi rgyud ni/

ku ru kulle'i rtog pa dang*/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa rnams so// lnga pa don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi rgyud la/ mgon po mngon 'byung dang*/ sgrol ma bla med kyi rgyud dang*/ phur pa rtsa dum dang gsum las/ dang po la paṇḍi ta sa manta shrī'i sgrub dkyil dang dbang bka' rong pa las brgyud pa la yod par bshad do// gnyis pa la/ nyi ma sbas pa'i sgrol ma lha nyi shu rtsa gcig so so'i sgrub thabs dang*/ spyi'i sgrub thabs/ nyi shu rtsa gcig lus la bkod pa lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rnams yod par gsungs so// drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ ji bzhin mnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud la sogs pa ste/ de ltar drug las 'dir sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud de/ de nyid la grub pa'i slob dpon chen po sa ra has sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel dang*/ lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi mngon par rtogs pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bcas bkral/ slob dpon a bha ya ka ras rgyud 'grel rgyas pa bkral ba rnams las/ 'dir slob dpon sa ra ha'i mngon dkyil rnams kyi dgongs pa ltar/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dkyil chog rnams la brten nas dbang bskur ba la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i phyogs dang*/ ras bris la brten pa'i phyogs gnyis skabs su gang bab ste/ ras bris ltar na sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ nub dang po sta gon gyi skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang sa'i lha mo sta gon dang*/ lha sta gon dang*/ bum pa sta gon te/ dang po gsum slob dpon gyis grub zin pa yin/ bzhi pa slob ma sta gon la/ maṇḍal gsol gdab nang dbang bskur// spro bskyed rgyun bshags lhar bskyed la// sgo gsum byin brlab mchod byas te// so shing khyor chu srung ku sha

/chos bshad rmi brtag sta gon no// zhes pa ste chos bcu bzhi las/ thog mar slob dpon la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal 'bul du bcug de ltar maṇḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag chen po bas// slob dpon khyod nyid dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen pos bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la gsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la gsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la gsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ de'i don ni/ slob dpon la dga' chen zhes bos nas/ byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de bdag la 'tshal ba'i slad du dam tshig ste sngags kyi sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshags las thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa stsal ba'i sgo nas thar pa chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer du gzhug tu gsol zhes pa'i don to// nang dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rnams slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis slar yang sbyangs nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lha mo'i padmar babs pas khyed rnams skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can re rer gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lha mo'i padmar bab pa khyed rnams he ru kar gsal ba'i spyi bor nas thim pas dbang bskur ba dang*/ ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan cig byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyis hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rnams he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis yum gyi dku g.yon pa nas 'thon te rang rang gi gral la 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byed pa'i dgos pa ni dbang gi dngos gzhi ma thob bar gyi gsang ba'i chos rnams nyan pa'i snod rung du bya ba dang*/ de dag gi skabs su slob dpon la yang gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i ched du bsgrub pa lags/ de nas gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga rnams// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de// skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni// bu khyod kyis ni bsrung bya ste// grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan// thabs ni gang yang yod ma yin// zhes pa ste/

de'i don ni khyed rnams cho ga'i sgo nas bur byas zin pa de la bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos te/ khyed rnams theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/ theg chen la'ang pha rol tu phyin pa dang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las mchog tu gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa de khyod la bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje'i theg pa 'di ni spyir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin zhing*/ khyad par du yang 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud btul zhing sangs rgyas su zin yang 'jig rten pa rnams drang ba'i phyir du/ slar yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'dzam bu gling du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ rtag par zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir du mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan pa yin no// de bas na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba 'di skal ba bzang ba yin pas/ kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang chen po thob pa'i phyir chos kyi bur gyur pa khyed rnams sngags kyi theg pa las blo gzhan du mi 'gyur ba gyis shig ces pa'i don to// rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thib pa ltar bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags par bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/

'khor 'das kun tu dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nye bar bstan pa'i don dam pa byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can de bdag gis kyang bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du yi dam 'cha' ba dang*/ yul thun mong ma yin pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa smon pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog cig snyam pa yongs su bsngo ba ste don de rnams yid la dran pa bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyun bshags lan gsum byas pa la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa sngar ma thob pa gsar du thob cing thob pa yar 'phel du byed pa yin no// de nas khyed rnams skad cig gis he ru kar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du dri'i thig le dang*/ dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams gsal gdab la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ sa bon de rnams las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa dang byin rlabs thams cad sgo gsum du thim par mos la/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing reg go /de ltar khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa de mchod yul du bzang ba yin pas/

me tog dbu la phul nas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ bdug spos shangs la/ dhū pe/ mar me spyan lam du/ ā lo ke dri'i byug pa thugs kar/ gandhe/ zhal zas ljags la/ nai wi tye āḥhūm̐/ snyan la rol mo phul te mchod par mos pa mdzod/ dril bu dkrol/ zhes pas mchod pa ni sgo gsum lhar shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod cig /ces pa'i don yin/ de ltar 'gal rkyen bar chad bsrungs nas lhar bskyed cing mchod nas/ mthun rkyen dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i thog mar so shing la brten nas brtag pa ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo me tog gi cod paṇa dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ he bha ga wa ti mu khaṃ pa ri shud dhaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid khyed rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i slad du sbyin par mos pa mdzod/ sngar gyi sngags de nyid kyis byin pa'i so shing de rgyu rin po che gser ram dngul las grub par mos te so brud pa bzhin byas pas rtse mo'i me tog las 'od zer byung ba zhal nas brgyud de khong par song bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang*/ dbang gi ye shes skye ba la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin skyugs par mos te/ ltos pa med par thal mo kha phye ste/ so shing gi rwa ba khru gang gru bzhi dri bzang gis byugs pa la tshom bu dgu bkod par dor te/ rtse mo gyen du lta ba'am/ rang la bstan na mchog gi dngos grub 'grub cing*/ mtshams dang*/ byang du 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub/ lho dang nub dang shar gyi dngos grub 'bring*/

rtse mo 'og tu bstan na sa 'og gi dngos grub tu 'gyur ro// de ni rnal 'byor chen po'i bum dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ so shing gis so dang kha la sogs pa lus gtso che ba'i dri ma sbyong ba bzhin bum dbang gis kyang gtso bor lus kyi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa lags/ rmi lam gsal po 'byung ba dang ngag gi dri ma sbyong byed khyor chu blud pa ni/ hūm̐ las byung zhing hūm̐ bzlas pa'i khyor chu/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ nishtsa sya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas lan gsum re byin la/ de ni gsang dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ khyor chus ngag gi dri ma sbyong ba bzhin/ gsang dbang gis kyang ngag gi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa'o// rmi lam la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir du srung skud sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ bzla zhing rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa'i srad bu gong ltar bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bsgril byas pa rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa rdo rje slob ma'i sgo gsum gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon

dngos gzhi gnyis pa'i tshe mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka zhes bsgyur/ gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te dam tshig gi srad bu la thim zhes dang*/ srung skud thal mo'i bar du bzung la gtso bo'i snying po bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ buddha mai tri rakṣa rakṣa sarbāṃ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i srung skud de skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su nyis skor du bcings/ las bum gyi chus gtor zhing*/ badzra a mṛ tas bsrung ngo*// de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ srung skud 'dogs pa shes rab ye shes kyi sbyang gzhi khams kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir du yin pa bzhin shes rab ye shes kyang khams bdud rtsi la bskur ba yin/ rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang mal stan lhag par gnas pa'i phyir du ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i phon po che chung gnyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥdang ha las byung ba'i ku sha che chung rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang dhīḥha bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas dhīḥbazlas pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas kyi don du phyag g.yas dang*/ ha bzlas pa'i che ba stan gyi don du g.yon par byin te/ de'i don ku sha ni 'dag byed kyi rdzas bla na med pa yin pa ltar/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyis kyang mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'dag par byed pas ku sha sbyin pa dbang bzhi pa'i sngon 'gro ste/ sngon byung bcom ldan 'das ku sha mi 'khrugs pa'i stan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas pa bzhin du khyed rnams kyang ku sha'i stan la nyal te rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu mngon du byas nas 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel lam du byed pa'i don to// chos zab mo bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/

'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen bdag /u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni// de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// bla na med par byed nus pa// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod yul 'dis// sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa'o// dang po'i bskal pa grangs med nas// bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang*// de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so// zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni/ 'jig rten na u dum wā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar sangs rgyas dkon te/ sangs rgyas zhig 'jig rten du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa na/ de dang khad nye ba'i sa phyogs zhig tu u dumbā ra'i me tog gcig 'byung la/ de yang rgyal rigs las 'byung na me tog dkar po dang*/ bram ze'i rigs las 'byung na ser po 'byung la/ sangs rgyas de lhums su zhugs pa na me tog de kha 'bus/ bltams pa ni kha bye/ gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa na rgyas/ dka' thub mdzad pa na cung zad rnying*/ 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa na rgyas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na shin tu rgyas/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa na skam nas 'gro ste/ des na de gnyis dkon mtshungs yin pas sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa dkon/ byon nas chos gsungs pa dkon/ chos kyi nang nas theg pa chen po gsungs pa dkon/ theg chen gyi nang nas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsung ba shin tu dkon no// dkon pas ci phan ri bong gi rwa dang nam mkha'i me tog kyang dkon no snyam na/ de dag dang mi mtshungs par dkon yang phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ bskal pa bye ba du ma nas bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba'i mod la 'dag par 'gyur na/ dbang blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan tan du byas nas sngags kyi spyod pa yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i thabs nyams su len pa dang*/

gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod la brtson pa'i sgo nas lam 'di la blo brtan par byas na ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyun gcod par 'gyur ba lta ci smos/ de bas na khyed rnams kyis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed kyis/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus pas yongs su bzung ste de'i rigs su skye bzhin par gyur pas na/ theg chen gyi lam mchog tu gyur pa 'di la brten nas myur du 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur bar gdon mi za bas don de la dga' ba khyad par can dang ldan par mdzod cig ces 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed nas/ rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang*// rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa// de kun nga la drang por smros// zhes bshad pas rang gi sgrub pa'i khang par bde ba'i mal zhig bcas te slob dpon gyis byin pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan du bting*/ gos dri ma med pa gyon/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab nas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal te/ sems dug gsum gyi rnam rtog thag ring du byas/ lha dang bla ma yid la dran bzhin pas/ sang nyin yi dam gyi lha'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar 'gyur ro snyam pa'i dga' spro dung nge ba'i sgo nas dran shes bzhin dang ldan par nyal na lung ston pa'i rmi lam 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de yang rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin// mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong*// de la mchod pa brtsam pa dang*// dge slong dag las chos nyan nam// yang na mi nyan na yang rung*// chos ni rnam par spyod pa dang*// de bzhin mdo sde rnam par spyod// ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang*/ mchod rten mthong ba dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam lag tu thogs pa/

dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus su zhugs pa/ rang gi bla ma las chos nyan pa dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ rgyal por dbang bskur ba/ rta dang glang po zhon pa/ nyi phug tu nyi ma lde ba/ dge slong dag dang chos kyi 'bel gtam byed pa/ zas bzang po ro brgya dang ldan pa thob pa 'bru'am bang mdzod la sogs pa'i gter rnyed pa/ skye bo mang pos bdag la 'dud bstod byed pa/ skye bo mang po la bdag nyid kyis chos bshad pa/ pha ma dang bla ma dang mdza' bshes dang 'phrad pa/ gos rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa la sogs pa rmi na rmi lam bzang ba yin pas sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring gang rung 'grub par shes par byas nas zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba bsgom zhing dga' ston bya/ gal te ngan pa'ang 'byung srid de/ de'i ltas ni/ rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzegs pa/ ka ra wī ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ mchod sdong dang bye ma dang thal phung la 'dzegs pa/ spre'u dang bong bu la zhon nas kha phyir phyogs te 'gro ba/ phag dang rnga mo dang ma he la zhon pa/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyod pa/ g.yang sa dang gcong rong du zhugs pa/ ri dang shing las lhung ba/ khyi dang khwa dang srin pos zos pa/ mi nag po lcags kyi dbyug pa can gyis bsdigs pa/ skra bregs pa/ lus til mar gyis byugs pa/ phreng ba dmar pos thod bcings pa la sogs pa byung na cung zad ngan pa yin pas/ gnyid sad ma thag tu chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med de/ don la grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bden med kyi sbyang ba'i rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin lung blangs te nyams su len pa dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byin pa'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos pa yin/ de rnams kyi slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub zin nas dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sang nyin 'byung ba lags/

bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa sogs kyis dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// de nas rjes chog mchod pa kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs nas/ sta gon gyi lha la mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba gdab cing*/ 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma byin nas/ sta gon gyi lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas rang gi snying gar bzhugs su gsol bar bya ste/ sta gon gyi cho ga'o// de nas nang par phyag dar dang skyang nul legs par byas te/ slob dpon he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas srad bu be'u lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyis nyis 'gyur du byas pa tshad dang ldan pa tshon lnga'i kha dog bsgyur ba thod pa'i nang du bzhag la/ bhrūm̐ āṃ dzrīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las rigs lngar bskyed pa la ye shes pa bcug la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas ye shes kyi srad bur byin gyis brlabs nas/ bla ma dang slob ma'i khu tshur gyis bzung ba rim pa ltar bsgril zhing*/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga te sarba dharmā spha ra spha ra a nu pra biṣṭa sarba dharma a dyanta a nu pṛ biṣṭa sarba dharma zhes pas gnyis su med par byas nas/ dza dza dza zhes brjod cing slob dpon gyis slob ma la gtad cing des kyang dza gsum brjod cing 'then te/ g.yon skor gyi rgyab nas 'gro bas byang dang lho'i thig oṃ badzra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags dang*/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i// sangs rgyas la sogs 'gro ba'i don// khyed kyi dus ni 'di yin no// zhes bskul zhing nam mkha' la thig gdab bo// de bzhin du nub dang shar nas gnyis pa gdab// me dang dbang ldan gnas pa yi// shar gyi logs thig gdab par bya// byang shar bden bral kha bltas pas// nub kyi phyogs kyang de bzhin gdab// bla ma mer gnas bden bral dang*// bla ma rlung dang dbang ldan du// gnas byas lho byang thig gdab bo// rlung dang dbang ldan phyogs gnas dang*// me dang bden bral khar gnas te// bla mas mtshams su thig gnyis gdab// ces pa'i rim pas ye shes kyi thig btab nas/

lag len ltar las kyi thig kyang rim pa bzhin du gdab par bya'o// de nas ro bsregs pa'i sol ba la sogs pa'i rdul tshon lnga la yi ge bris pa ye shes kyi thig bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab grol byed// sangs rgyas thod pa rgyal chen po// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// nyes pa ma lus rab zhi ba'i// tshon gyi las la yang dag 'jug /ces brjod cing*/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi dbang ldan nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyi rgyun mi chad par sngon po dang*/ dkar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ ljang gu rnams mthe'u chung nas mthe bo'i bar tsam du drangs pa thod pa'am snod gtsang mas bkab nas phyi nas slob mas bri bar bya'o// de'ang 'dab brgyad sna tshogs lte bar bcas// padma'i lte ba sngon po bri// dkar ser dmar zhing gnag pa rnams// shar dang byang sogs phyogs kyi tshon// mtshams bzhir mdzes pa'i padma la// bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pas mdzes// rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas brgyan// de 'og rim pa gnyis pa ni// 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dmar po la// rtsibs tshon ljang gu dag kyang ldan// padma dmar po'i phreng bas brgyan// rim pa gsum pa'i 'khor lo'i ni// rtsibs brgyad kha dog dkar po la// rtsibs mchan kha dog nag por bri// de yang rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan// phyi rol gru bzhi lham pa la// sgo bzhi rta babs rnams kyis brgyan// ba dan rnam pa bzhi yis brgyan// drwa ba drwa ba phyed pas brgyan// phyi rol kha khyer mdzes pa dang*// rin chen pha gu yang dag ldan// mtshan ma dgod pa ni/ pha rol dbus kyi lte ba la// ro steng rdo rje nag po dang*// gri gug dmar po legs par dgod// pad 'dab 'khor lo rnams kyis steng*// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i// gri gug lha mo'i mdog bzhin bri// sgo bzhi rnams su'ang de bzhin no// zhes pa ltar dgod do// de nas bla bres dang gos dang rgyal mtshan dang spos dang*/

me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bkod pas mdzes par byas pa/ ras bris ltar na sngar sta gon gyi tshom bu'i gnas su ras bris dgram pa la/ mchod rdzas sogs yo byad rnams sta gon gyi skabs ltar bsham mo// phyi nyin rdo rje slob dpon rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ las thams cad pa'i chus gtor zhing mchod pa rnams bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ hūm̐ las mchod pa'i rdzas bskyed pa rnams rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas dpag tu med par spel zhing rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang ba sogs nas/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par bskyed pa'i lha'i gnas rnams su padma nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las skad cig gis lha rnams gsal bar bskyed pa la sta gon gyi lha rnams snying ga nas sprul pa bstims te byin gyis brlabs/ yang snying ga'i hūm̐ gis ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs nas dbang bskur te/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar yongs su rdzogs par bya'o// de nas mchod pa byin rlabs gong du byas na 'dir mi dgos shing*/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog la sogs pa nas gos zung gi bar rnams lha grangs dang mthun pa'i phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba la sogs pa nang gi mchod pa dang*/ yid byung gi mchod pa rnams dang*/ bkra shis kyi glu yis bstod pa'i bar thams cad sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas la bzlas pas kyang mnyes par byas mthar/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/

zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo// de nas phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ zlum gtor bshams pa la sbyang ba la sogs pa byas pa'i gtor ma zhing skyong rnams la byin nas bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la las bum gyi chu 'thung zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus byas te maṇḍal 'bul ba nas brtsams te 'jug cing dbang blang ba rnams ni mtshams sbyor brda sprod rnams dor ba ma gtogs 'og gi slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin bdag 'jug gi tshul du dbang rdzogs par blang ngo*// de nas gtor bsngo bya ba ni/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu/ lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang*/ rigs drug gi 'gro ba thams cad bkug ste/ mdun bskyed kyi mthar 'khod pa thams cad kyang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du gyur ces brjod la/ de thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ sogs kyis go cha bcing ba dang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa'i bar byas/ gtor ma bstab pa ni/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams/ oṃ buddha ka pā li ni maṇḍa la ba liṃ sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ 'khor gyi zhing skyong dang 'byung po rnams la/ oṃ ma hā ka pā la badzre sogs nas tshim par bsams la bar dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan sogs nas gnas par shog ces pa'i bar gyis gtor ma btang ba rnams ni sgrub thabs kyi mjug tu bstan pa ltar bya ba rnams ni slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i brda sprod ni/ sta gon byas pa'i slob ma rnams gral rim bzhin 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu byas nas/ slob dpon gyis 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/

de'i ched du zab pa las kyang shin tu zab pa'i dbang bskur ba gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa yang rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la rang re rnams kyi rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa re byed dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan don dam par sems can thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin na yang*/ gnas skabs glo bur gyi dri ma sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma spangs kyi bar la rgyun chad med par sdug bsngal gyi 'khor mo yug tu gyur pa'i 'khor bar skye zhing*/ 'khor ba'i skye gnas gang du skyes kyang bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las ma 'das pa yin te/ sdug bsngal can gyi sems can rnams kyi pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med pas 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag pa'i slad du tshe 'di'i bya ba snying po med pa thams cad spangs te/ buddha ka pā li zhes pa ste/ de'ang buddha ni sangs rgyas dang*/ ka pā la ni bde ba skyong ba ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang thabs bde ba chen po ste de gnyis dbyer med par skyong ba'i bdag nyid can gyi dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'i ched du grub pa'i slob dpon chen po grub chen sa ra ha pa nas brgyud pa'i bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ bden gnyis zung 'jug tu rtogs pa'i lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas/ bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/

rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa dbang gong ma gsum blangs la dam tshig la bsrung bsdam dang*/ lam la'ang ci nus kyi sgo nas 'bad par bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi sems dung pa zhig bskyed mdzod/ de nas sta gon du gnas pa yan chad grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du btang nas dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa dang*/ go cha bgo ba'i tshul gyis sgrub pa dang*/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug gi tshul gyis sgrub pa dang*/ dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa ste rnam pa bzhis bsgrubs nas/ nang du dkyil 'khor pa mchod pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor mas tshim par bya ba rnams dgos te/ de dag legs par grub pa byas pa yin/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang rnams rang rgyud kyi dam tshig gso ba'i blos bdag 'jug gi tshul gyis len pa dang*/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i phyir du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul dgos pa rnams grub zin nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i phyir du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis yod pa las/ dang po 'jug pa la/ maṇḍal gsol gdab dris lan blan// snyan gsan mig ras me tog gtad// phyag lnga chus gtor nang du gzhug /rgyun bshags sbrags gzung nang sems bskyed// chus gtor nang gzhug gsol ba gdab// ye shes dbab brten lhar gsol gdab// me tog dor dang kha dog dri// mig bsal lha bstan 'jug pa'o// zhes pa ltar las/

'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du lus longs spyod dge ba'i dbang po dang bcas pa gling bzhi ri rab lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam par sprul te phul bar mos la maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// don dam smra ba'i seng ge'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba// nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa// srid pa nyes brgya bskyed pa'i nyon mongs gcod mdzad pa// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab/ sngon chad sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du slob dpon gyis mig dar dmar po res gdong g.yogs byin te/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas gdong bcings nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag rten gyi slad du u dub wā ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re yang byin par mos/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas byin nas/ bla mas kye khyod su zhig dris pa'i lan/ bris pa'i lan btab par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag ni rgyal ba'i sras po zhes brjod do// de nas slob dpon gyis langs te/ dkyil 'khor la zhal phyogs par/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes lha la gsol ba btab nas/ de nas khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgo nas phyag byas par mos te/ thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na ma te hūm̐/

na ma mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing sgo gsum gus pas phyag bya'o// yang de nyid nas/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gī nī pū dza u pastha na ya ātma naṃ nirya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gī nī ātma naṃ nirya ma le a dhi tiṣṭha swa maṃ/ zhes pas lus kyi phyag bya/ yang g.yon skor du phyin te/ shar nas thal mo snying ga'i g.yon du sbyar la rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gī nī pū dza u pastha na ya a bhi ṣe kā ya ātma naṃ nirya trā ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni atma kā la ma hā a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes pas phyag bya/ byang nas thal mo dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gī ni pū dza pra warta ya ātma naṃ nirya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta bi ra yo gī nī ātma mai maṃ pra warta na ya maṃ/ zhes pas phyag bya/ nub nas thal mo mgor bzhag la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gī ni pū dza karma ātma naṃ nirya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gī ni atma arya kārma ku ru maṃ/ zhes pas phyag bya'o// de nas las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus gtor/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs brjod la/ de nas khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi drung du 'khod par mos la/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thib ltar bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar sdig pa thams cad bshags pa dang*/ skye 'phags kyi dge ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang rdo rje slob dpon dang gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ byang chub tu sems smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa ste thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa sogs nas/ bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas/ sdom pa sbyin pa la/ dang po sbrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yin te// sdom pa rtag par gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni// slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar gyis// byang chub sems dpa' gang rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes su grags// slob dpon khyod kyis gzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad// rin chen rigs pa rtag tu ni// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// chos dang mi 'jigs zang zing gi /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang rtag tu gzung*// 'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya// zhes pa'i don ni 'dzin rgyu'i dam tshig la rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig gnyis las/ spyi'i dam tshig ni gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du nyes spyod sdom pa dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang*/ sems can gyi don ci nus su sgrub pa dam bca' ba/ 'jug pa sems bskyed pa rnams yin/ gnyis pa so so'i dam tshig ni/ sangs rgyas te rnam snang gi dam tshig ni phyi nang gsang ba'i dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa yin te/ rnam snang sangs rgyas kyi sku yin pas yon tan gyi rten byed pa ltar/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i sdom pas kyang sdom pa thams cad kyi rten byed pa'i phyir ro// rdo rje ste mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig ni phyi nang gsang ba'i rdo rje dril bu/

phyag rgya slob dpon rnams 'dzin pa ste mi bskyod pa thugs rdo rje byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo yin pa ltar/ dam tshig gsum dang slob dpon yang byang chub kyi sems kyis 'dzin pas so// rin chen te rin 'byung gi dam tshig ni/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams pa'i sbyin pa rnams nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste dus drug tu gtong ba'am/ dngos su mi nus na 'dun pa dang ma bral bar byas te/ rin 'byung sbyin pa'i ngo bo ser sna rnam par dag pa yin pa ltar/ sbyin pa yang dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang ser sna'i gnyen po yin pas so// padma ste 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig ni/ phyi bya spyod/ nang rnal 'byor/ gsang ba rnal 'byor bla med de rgyud sde bzhi dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ byang chub sems dpa' ste theg pa gsum dang bcas pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i dam 'cha' ba ste 'od dpag med shes rab kyi ngo bo gsung rnam par dag pa yin pa ltar/ chos kyang shes rab kyis 'dzin cing gsung gis ston pas so// las kyi rigs te don yod grub pa'i dam tshig ni sdom pa thams cad 'dzin pa dang mchod pa'i las la brtson par bya ba yin te/ don yod grub pa brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo phrin las kyi rang bzhin yin pa ltar/ dge ba la spro ba'i brtson 'grus kyi sdom pa 'dzin pa dang sangs rgyas la mchod pa byed pa gnyis ka'ang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rjes su skyong ba yin pas so// de ltar rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces pa'i bar lan gsum brjod pas sdom pa bzung ba'o// nang gi sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu/

de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhig byung bar mos pa ste/ de gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badzra yo ga tsitta utpa da ya mi/ zhes pas rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa de brtan pa'i ched du slob dpon gyis me tog phreng ba dang bcas pas rdo rje slob ma'i snying gar gtugs te/ oṃ su ra ti sa ma ya st+waṃ ho siddhi badzra ya tha su khaṃ zhes pas brtan par byas pa mos/ gsang ba gdams pa ni/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di khyod kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar ma byed cig ma dad pa rnams la ma yin no// zhes brjod nas sgo ba rnams kyis slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi nang du khrid par mos la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas dam la bzhag pa la/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gi khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes pas dam tshig sbrags nas/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes dang*/ mna' chu sbyin pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/

dri zhim po'i chu la rnam rgyal bum chu cung zad blugs pa byin te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'gyur// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thungs// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ zhes brjod par bya'o// bla ma'i bka' mnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya'o// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar gyur ta re zhes pas dam la bzhag nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma// thams cad kyis ni byin rlobs la// he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor ma// bdag la ye shes dbab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab ste/ de'ang ye shes dbab pa zhes pa'i don ni/ rang la 'byung rung gi ye shes pa rang rgyud la grub zin pa ma yin zhing*/ gzhan rgyud la grub zin gyi ye shes pa bdag la 'pho ba ma yin yang*/ gzhan rgyud la grub zin gyi ye shes pa lha la sogs pa'i rnam pa can du sngags dang rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'bebs pa'i cho ga byas pa la brten nas rang rgyud la 'byung rung gi ye shes pa mngon du gyur pa la ye shes phebs pa'i tha snyad byed pa lags pa de'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas te/ de'i ngang nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rnams kyi snying gar rgya mtsho la char bab pa ltar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/

rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ oṃ tiṣṭha ma hā kro dha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid mahya bidyā ra dza ya dhi ma he swā hā/ des kyang ye shes pheb par ma gyur na/ sbogs pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor he ru ka yab yum yungs kar tsam gyi sku snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i 'od zer dmar pos lus kun tu bde ba chen po'i ros gang ba bsgom du bcug la/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ ro ras dang*/ byi la'i brun dang*/ gu gul nag po dang*/ grir shi ba'i khrag dang*/ klad pa dang*/ tshil chen dang*/ rang gi skra dang bcas pa mer bsregs pas bdug cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas sngar gyi sngags mang du brjod cing ye shes dbab/ zhes mang du bskul bas nges par 'bab par 'gyur ro// de nas slob ma'i lce la a dmar po bsams nas/ gsungs shig rdo rje dge mi dge /zhes brjod nas ye shes phab pa de brtan pa'i slad du spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag cing*/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra zhes pas brtan par bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis langs pas dkyil 'khor la zhal phyogs pas/ 'dir ni bsod nams ji lta bu// lha rnams rim gyi rim ji bzhin// 'dir ni dngos grub gang yin pa// dkyil 'khor 'di ni de bzhin shog /zhes brjod nas/ dkyil 'khor la me tog 'bul ba ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs/ de'ang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yongs su dag pa gcig nyid gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir du gtso bo dang 'khor gyi rnam pa can du bstan pa tsam ma gtogs/ rang gi ngo bo la bzang ngan nam mchog dman gyi khyad par cung zad kyang med mod/ 'on kyang gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir du gtso 'khor du bstan pa tsam yin pas/ rang gi las 'bras yod pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog shig snyam pas/

pra tītstsha badzra hoḥzhes pas dkyil 'khor du me tog dor nas/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha des khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bcings nas/ me tog mgo la bzhag cing me tog phreng ba'i dbang byin par mos/ de nas khyed rnams mig mig ras dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang la gzigs pa re mdzod/ kye khyed kyi mig lam la ci mthong*/ bar snang gi kha dog dris la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ zhes pas ma rig pa'i ling thog mig ras lhan cig bsal nas/ dkyil 'khor la lta ba bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro don phun sum tshogs don dang*// dngos grub kun khyod sngon du gyur// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par bgyi// zhes brjod nas/ de nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yis// lha yi sku mdog ji bzhin du// mtshan ma la sogs de bzhin du// slob ma rnams la brtan par bya// zhes pa ste dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs te/ de'ang phyi rol du rdo rje nag po'i rwa ba drwa ba dang gur dang rdo rje'i sa gzhi gyur pa'i phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang*/ chos 'byung gi dbus su chud pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang*/ rin po che'i pha gu dang*/ drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ g.yer kha'i drwa bas mdzes shing nang ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar spras pa rdo rje'i gdung zlum po la brten nas steng thog rim par phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa de'i dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/

de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa nyis rim pa/ dbus su nyi ma dang ro'i gdan/ phyogs bzhi'i padma dang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa nyis rim gyi rtsibs rnams dang*/ phyi'i sgo bzhi rnams su nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re dang bcas pa'i rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni dbus su bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog sngon po 'jigs shing khros pa'i bdag nyid can zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa sogs nas mi mgo'i phreng ba dang mchod phyir thogs med cing*/ gzhan rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o zhes pa'i bar yum dang bcas pa sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ shar gyi 'dab ma la phreng ba ma dkar mo/ byang gi 'dab ma la 'dod can ma ser mo/ nub kyi 'dab ma la 'jigs ma dmar mo/ lho'i 'dab ma la thub dka' ma nag mo/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma la bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i thod pa re re dang bcas pa/ padma'i phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa ni thugs kyi 'khor lo'o// rim pa gnyis pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i phyi rol padma'i phreng bas brgyan pa'i shar gyi rtsibs la dge ba'i ska rags ma/ byang du gzugs can ma/ nub tu rnam rgyal ma/ lhor byed ma/ dbang ldan du thod can ma/ mer mtshon chen ma/ bden bral du rgyu byed ma/ rlung du sdud byed ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo gsung gi 'khor lo'o// rim pa gsum pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa'i shar gyi rtsibs la sgrol byed ma/ byang du 'jigs ma/ nub tu lā ma/ lhor mi pham ma/ dbang ldan du dge ma/ mer 'dzur byed ma/ bden bral du dus mtshan ma/ rlung du grags chen ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo sku'i 'khor lo'o// 'khor lo gsum gyi lha mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dkris shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

'od zer rnon pos gtibs shing skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba kha nas khrag 'thor zhing khu ba dang ldan pa'o// shar sgor mdzes ma dkar mo/ byang sgor nor 'dzin ma ser mo/ nub sgor skal bzang ma dmar mo/ lho sgor grags mthong ma nag mo ste/ sgo ba bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas shing he ru ka la kun tu blta ba dang bcas pa ni brten pa lha ste/ mdor na bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam sgyu ma lta bur mthong snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// yon gsol stegs bzhag byur bsal shis// dbang drug bskur la brtul zhugs gnyis// rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung ngo*// de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇḍal phul nas rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang lhan cig zhu ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob cing gzi brjid can// de ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso// de bzhin bdag la deng mdzod cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid// zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgor padma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i steng du seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pa'i stan bting pa'i steng du khyed rnams he ru ka yab yum gyi skur gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po phub pa dang bcas pa ste 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i byur bsal bar mos la/ yungs kar gyis brab cing*/

sumbha ni sogs khro bo'i sngags brjod cing bgegs bskrad do// dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs slob dpon dang bcas pas bum pa khyed rnams kyi phyogs su yo ba dang bcas te me tog gi char dbab cing bkra shis kyi cho ga rgyas par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la dril bu'i sgra dang bcas te/ phun sum tshogs 'dzin sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ de rnams kyis sbyor ba'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la spro na 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa rang bzhin 'od gsal chen po sogs nas/ zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel pas mi bslu ba'i phyir thob pa des grol bar 'gyur ba yin no// zhes pa'i bar gyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sogs kyi brda sprod rnams spro na/ kye rdo rje'i dbang bshad lung rigs man ngag gi snying po bsdus pa ltar brjod kyang legs/ gal te ma byung kyang chad skyon med/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i dang po mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang la/ las bum chus gtor zhing*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ khyed rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis padma dang nyi ma'i steng du khyed rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi bskyod pa he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbang rdzas mi bskyod pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs nam mkha'i gtos khyab pa/

oṃ buddha ka pā li ni a khaṃ sogs sngags dang bcas pas spyan drangs la/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor ma gos sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa brgyad mdun gyi nam mkhar bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis yongs su gang zhing a mra'i shing gis kha brgyan pa thogs pa sprul pa la/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i don du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bskur byed nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi chus khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ bla ma dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// gsang gsum pa yi gnas las byung*// khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa// chu yi dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes pas chus dbang bskur ro// zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob par mos pa mdzod/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mos me tog la sogs pas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs lngas mchod/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa yin no// zhes brjod/ 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre de nyid kyis shes par byas la/ rin chen 'byung ldan cod paṇa gyi dbang gi slad du/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā wa dang*/ khyed rnams kyi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

ral pa'i thor cog dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba las dbu rgyan du gyur/ dbang lha spyan 'dren mi dgos/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ bskur byed nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bor rin 'byung gi rang bzhin gyi cod paṇa dang dar dpyangs bcings te dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ thor tshugs cod paṇa gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dam pa'i dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ badzra pa ṭa ka badzra a ra li hoḥzhes brjod cing dbu rgyan bcing bar bya'o// nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ puṣpe sogs lngas mchod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang skal ba mnyam par byas pa yin no// zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang gi slad du/ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ khyed rnams kyi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med he ru ka sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas padma dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa sogs nas bzhugs pa/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med zhu ba las dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pas 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa re khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas su byin par mos/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba// de ring khyed la bskur bar bya// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// shin tu grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ badzra a dhi pa dhi st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/

zhes pas rdo rje lag tu byin nas/ 'dir rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dam tshig gsum las/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi slad du/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la thugs gtad mdzod/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces pa ste/ de'i don ni/ rdo rje 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med dang skal ba mnyam par byas/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ dril bu'i dbang la/ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ khyed rnams kyi 'du shes kyi phung po dang*/ dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa he ru ka sku mdog ljang gu g.yas ral gri g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa sogs nas bzhugs pa/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa zhu ba dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ bskur byed nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas don grub kyi rang bzhin gyi dril bu phyag g.yon du byin te/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tiṣṭha bī ra sa ma ya zhes pas lag pa g.yon du dril bu gtad de/
