dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi slad du/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi bdag /ngo bo nyid kyi dngos med byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' rnams// dam pa'i srid pa skye bar shog /zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni/ dril bu 'di ni chos kyi dbyings skye 'gag thams cad dang bral ba mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi ngag srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa dang skal ba mnyam par byas/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang gi slad du/ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ khyed rnams kyi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rnams kyi gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas 'khor lo g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu sogs nas bzhugs pa/ de la phyag rgya chen po sku'i dam tshig dang ming gi dbang lhan cig pa'i don du/ khyed rnams rdo rje dril bu bsnol te 'khyud pa'i phyag rgyas bzung nas/ gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor bdag /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs// byin rlabs che ldan sngags kyi ni// dbang gis dbang bskur sbyin par bya// zhes dang*/ rdo rje dril bu lhan cig 'dzin pas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa dhi st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ shrī he ru ka nā ma a dhi ṣi ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i ming gi dbang bskur ro// puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/

gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad dang skal ba mnyam par byas zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi slad du/ swa bhā wa dang*/ khyed rnams kyi phung po lngas chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ khyed rnams kyi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa ral pa'i sogs nas bzhugs pa/ de la brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi don du/ phyag g.yas su rdo rje byin te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā siddhi badzra sa ma ya e ṣa st+waṃ dha ra ya mi hūm̐ ha ha ha hoḥzhes pas lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin te rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa'o// slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs kyi slad du/ khyed rnams skad cig gis he ru ka yab yum gyi skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la lag pa g.yon par thod pa dang*/ g.yas par ḍā ma ru dang*/ gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ se ral khar tshangs skud byin nas/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭwāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rdo rjer bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog cing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭwāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis// zhes pas thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ste/ de'i don yang khā ṭwāṃ ga ni lha sku bde ba chen po/ ḍā ma ru ni shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra/ thod pa ni bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa ste/

de dag dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces brjod ḍā ma ru dkrol tshul dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ngo*// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar byed dang mnan la sogs// bsad dang bskrad pa ma lus pa'i// las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis// ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil lh+wam de bzhin ril bu ste// rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub rnams// de nas ci dgar sgrub par gyis// zhes pa ste/ zhi sogs dman pa bzhi dang grub chen brgyad de/ de'ang thun mong gi dngos grub ral gri khar bcug nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang*/ mig la mig sman byugs nas 'jig rten gsum mthong ba dang*/ sa 'og gi gter bum bton nas sems can rnams la ci 'dod pa ster ba dang*/ rkang pa la rdzas byugs nas rkang mgyogs dang*/ ril bu khar bcug nas sus kyang mi mthong zhing gnod sbyin ltar 'dod pa'i gzugs bsgyur ba dang*/ thig le dpral bar byas nas bdag sus kyang mi mthong ba dang*/ tshe nyi zla ltar gnas pa dang*/ lus lo bcu drug lon pa 'dra ba dang*/ lcags zangs gser du bsgyur ba dang*/ gsum po de la bcud len zhes gsungs te tshe dang lus dang longs spyod kyi bcud len dang*/ bu mo dam pa dgug pa ni gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa'i sgo nas te/ de dag sgrub pa'i sgo nas kyang rang gzhan la phan 'dogs par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin no// de nas lung bstan pa ni/ lung phal cher sangs rgyas sprul sku'i rnam pas ston srid pas/ skabs 'dir slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal can gyi lag pa g.yon gyis chos gos kyi grwa nas bzung zhing*/ g.yas kyi mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che// 'khor lo ma lus rnam gnas shing*// he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin// mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis// 'di ni nga yi lung bstan te// he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs// dngos po mchog tu bsgrub pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// shrī he ru ka nā ma dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba sarba ta thā ga tā siddha sa ma ya st+waṃ bhur bhu ba swā/

gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu lung bstan par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no zhes pas lung bstan/ de nas dbugs dbyung bar bya ste/ gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// mthong ba dang ni btsud pa yis// sdig pa kun las grol bar 'gyur// khyod ni shin tu de ring gnas// dbang ni bskur ba tsam gyis ni// slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur// slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yi// brtan dang g.yo ba'i dam tshig yin// sems dag tho rangs dus langs te// bza' dang bsrung ba la sogs pa'i// sdom pa'i bdag nyid can bsrung ngo*// lus dang srog la mi ltos par// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung*// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// rtag tu bzlas la gzhol bar byos// gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// zla ba re re bsrung ba ni// gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo gnas// tshes bcu'i dus su mchod par bya// sha dang chang sogs gang ci'ang rung*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// he ru ka sogs rab tu mchod// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// sems can don la rgyab phyogs min// 'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spangs// mya ngan 'das la dga' mi bya// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la// khyod kyis brnyas pa mi bya'o// phyag rgya gzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o// dam tshig rab bsrung bsod nams kyis// tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur// bud med thams cad mthong ba na// g.yon nas lan gsum bskor byas nas// spyi bo'i phyag ni byas nas kyang*// lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab// bdag ni ma khyod bu yin te// ji srid byang chub 'gyur bar du// byang chub yan lag nu ma las// byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs// gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i// bslab pa blang ba sngon 'gro bas// tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrungs// dam tshig de la rtag gnas te// de sngon 'gro ba'i gsang ba yin// spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur// de'i don ni khyed rnams sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen por sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis mthun par gsung zhing*/

bu sdug pa ltar yongs su dgongs pa'i phyir/ deng phyin chad khyed rnams rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas/ de'i las su bya ba dkyil 'khor 'dri ba la sogs pa dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig 'khor lo sdom pa nas ji skad bshad pa rnams kyang bsrung bsdam tshul bzhin du byas na dngos grub thams cad tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i don te/ ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa de rnams kyang tshul bzhin du bsrung ngo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal// zhes brjod par bya'o// de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// gsang dbang dgos pa yon gsol gdab// mig dgab gsang dbang mig ras 'grol// zhes pa ltar de nas gsang dbang nod par 'dod pas de'i dgos pa ni/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim// shi ma thag tu stong par 'gyur// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// ye shes kun gyi stong par 'gyur// zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni gsang ba'i dbang ma bskur ba lam bsgoms kyang ye shes mi skye ba dpe'i sgo nas bstan pa ltar gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ slob mas sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rgyan dang mchod pa rnams kyis mchod cing*/ lang tsho la babs pa'i rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'bul bar mos la/ maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug maṇḍal phul nas bla ma he ru ka chen po la rab tu dad cing dri ma med pa'i sems kyis gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'khor ba 'dam du bying ba bdag /dpung gnyen khyod kyis bsgral du gsol// bdag ni rtsol chung skal dman zhing*// sangs rgyas chos ni rnam par spangs// kye kye ston pa bla ma che// mgon po khyed kyis brtse bar mdzod// ces lan gsum brjod de/

sngon chad gsang dbang ma thob pa'i brdar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsung zhing mig ras 'ching bar zhu/ de'ang chu la sogs pa'i bum dbang sngon du song zin pa'i slob ma zhig la gsang dbang bskur ba ste/ de'ang*/ dam tshig phyag rgyar rab gsungs pa// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// gang gi lus kun brtan byed pa// de ni phyag rgyar rab tu grags// zhes brjod nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas thod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems mu tig rdog ma lta bu slob ma'i lce la bzhag par mos te/ gsang dbang gi rdzas slob ma'i khar byin pa mgrin par mid pas zag med kyi bde bas tshim par gyur nas/ a ti su ṣa zhes gsung zhing myang bar zhu/ de ltar myangs pas mgrin par gzhir gnas pa'i ya ra la wa zhes pa'i yi ge byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba dam tshig pa'i tshul du gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyis byin pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du 'dres pas/ snang mched thob gsum gyi 'khor du byung ba'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rags pa rnams 'gags nas/ stong pa dang shin tu stong pa chen po'i nyams skyes te/ snang ba gsum gyi rang bzhin stong pa gsum ro gcig tu gyur pa gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos la cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ khams gsum thabs dang shes rab gcig /bde chen gnyis med ye shes gsal// slob ma nus dang ldan par 'gyur// de ltar dbang chog bskur byas pas// mgon po sa bcu dang mnyam 'gyur// zhes pa ste/ 'di'i dbang bskur bas slob ma sa bcu thob pa dang tshul mtshungs pa yin no zhes pa'i don te/ de ltar na dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsung zhing mig ras 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag

lam tsand+ra li bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// gsum pa yon gsol dgos pa dang*/ mig dgab dbang dngos mig ras 'grol/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug de ltar phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rnam por rtog pa mang po yis// g.yogs pa'i bag chags rab ldan pa// 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba bdag /mdzes ma khyod kyis skyob par mdzod// grags chen snying rjer ldan pa yis// lha mo des ni zhi bar mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas mig ras 'ching*/ dbang bskur ba'i dgos pa ni/ dper na pi wang sbyor kun tshogs// rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung*// de bzhin dbang dad bral ba ni// sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur// zhes pa ste dbang gsum pa ma bskur bar lam bsgoms kyang sngags dang bsam gtan mi 'grub pa'ang pi wang rgyud dang bral ba'i dpes bstan pa yin no// de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing yid du 'ong ba zhig sprul te slob ma la gtad nas/ gang gi shes rab mnyes pa yis// sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ni mchod// 'di nyid la ni sangs rgyas bzhugs// gzhan yang dngos grub gtso ba dang*// snying rje ldan pa gzhan gang zhig /mkha' 'gro ma kun 'di la bzhugs// zhes gnang ba byin te/ de yab sangs rgyas thod pa dang yum sna tshogs bde ma gsal ba lha'i 'du shes/ yum gyi bha ga a las padma/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan skyes ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te 'du shes gsum dang ma bral bas/ btsum pa dang*/ 'khyud pa dang*/ bsrub pa dang*/ cher bsrubs pas sbyor bas byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ de nas snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/

de nas lte bar byon pas dga' bral/ de nas yab yum mkha' gsang rtser byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par mos pa mdzod/ shes rab padma'i nang dbus su// dpag tshad bye bas dkyil 'khor la// gsum brtsegs dga' ba'i bdag nyid lus// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa// dkyil 'khor de yi dbus gnas pa// mkhas pa slob ma bzang dbang bskur// gal te bla med byang chub 'dod// phyi yi dkyil 'khor bya ba min// lha rnams bshig pa tsam gyis ni// sdig pa chen po skye bar 'gyur// des na rdul tshon tsam gyis ni// de bzhin lha rnams dag mi 'gyur// rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dang*// de bzhin padma ral gri nyid// byas na slar yang 'chi byed pa// skyes bu tha shal dmyal bar 'gro// gang gi sangs rgyas spyan 'dren zhing*// gang gis gshegs su gsol ba yis// rdo rje sems dpa' byon pa dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa byon pa rnams// gang na'ang bzhugs pa ma yin te// dri ma med cing dag pa'i lus// gang gi spyan drangs gshegs su gsol// de nyid kyis na rtag med pa// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams phyag bya// zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pas/ phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba 'di ni mchog yin gyi/ de las gzhan pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sogs ni lha bshig par 'gyur ba'i sdig pa 'byung ba la sogs pas phyi'i dkyil 'khor sogs ni dman pa nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni gang gis spyan 'dren pa dang*/ 'byon pa sogs gang du'ang yod pa ma yin na'ang*/ dri ma med cing dag pa'i bdag nyid can rnams ni/ gshegs pa dang bzhud pa'i tshul ston pa tsam zad do zhes pa'i don te/ de yas bab kyi dga' ba yin/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bsgrub pa'i slad du/ byang chub kyi sems mkha' gsang gi rtse mor rlung 'pho ba med pa'i stobs kyis bzung ba ste/

slar yi ge hūm̐ gi gdangs can gyi rlung gis drangs te/ lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ dpral bar byon pas khyad par dga' ba/ gtsug tor du byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba brtan par byas/ de'i tshe byang chub kyi sems kyis lus thams cad la khyab/ de thams cad la bde bas khyab/ de thams cad la mi rtog pas khyab ste/ bde stong dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin skyes par mos pa mdzod/ 'bru gsum dang mig ras 'grol/ de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// bzhi pa yon dbul gsol ba gdab// mig dgab dbang dngos mig ras 'grol// de nas dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug /maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod zhabs padma'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bos dbang bskur rnam gsum gnang*// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ sngon chad dbang bzhi pa ma thob pa'i brdar 'bru gsum gyis mig ras 'ching*/ khyed rnams kyi dbang gsum pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i dus su rtog pa thams cad 'gags nas sems nyid bde ba chen por rig pa'i ye shes des mtshon pa'i don gyi ye shes don dam pa byang chub kyi sems de nyid tshig tsam gyi sgo nas ngo sprad pa ni/ gang du dbang po 'gags gyur pa// bdag rtogs rang bzhin nyams pa ste// kye de lhan cig skyes gyur pa// bla ma'i zhal sngar gsal bar zhus// zhes pa ste/ de nyams su len pa/ khyed rnams lus mnyam gzhag gi spyod lam dang ldan zhing*/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag yid rnam rtog gi spro bsdu'am dus gsum gyi rtog pa thams cad spangs te/ yul gzugs sgra la sogs pa gang la'ang mi 'jug par sngar gyi dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi dpe'i ye shes kyi steng du rtogs par bya ba ni/

rang nyid dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul pa'i sku dang*/ de'i sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rnam par shar ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ lha sku bde ba chen po'i rnam par snang ba de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad dang bral ba chos kyi sku dang*/ de gsum ldog tshul tha dad kyang rang bzhin so sor dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ mdor na zhes pas yul dang dbang po dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rnams 'gags shing*/ mnyam pa nyid mi rtog pa nyid du gnas pa ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dbang bzhi pa yin no// dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bgrol bar zhu/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum char gyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// de ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul/ der ma zad lus longs spyod rnams kyang 'bul gyi cha shas nas longs spyod du gsol snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes brjod par bya'o// de'ang dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang bskur ba thob pa'i phan yon ni/ mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang*// rmongs dang ma rungs las byed dang*// skye ba dman 'gyur 'gro ba rnams// rdul tshon mthong bas grol bar 'gyur// dkyil 'khor dag tu mngon zhugs pa// gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur// shin tu sbyor ba'i sems kyis ni// skye 'di dngos grub ma thob kyang*// skye gzhan srid par dngos grub 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de ltar phan yon chen po dang ldan yang rang nyid la dbang bka' med par gzhan la dbang bskur ba ni nyes pa shin tu che ste/

rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par// bdag gi dbang bskur zhes smra ba// ji srid sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar// slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro// zhes so// des na/ gang yang bla ma brgyud pa yi// rim 'ong de nyid rigs pa yis// sgrub pa po yi 'grub snyam dgongs// zhes 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o// bsod nams 'di yis sogs kyis slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang bstod pa 'dod don zhu ba rnams byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol la/ rdul tshon rnams gser la sogs pa'i bum par bsdus la chu bor dor zhing phur bu rnams phyung nas/ dri zhim po'i chu dang ba byung la sogs pas thig rjes bkrus la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// ras bris ltar na phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas/ su pra tiṣṭha'i bar gyis brtan bzhugs bya/ rang gi snying gar oṃ/ dpral bar haṃ sogs kyis go cha bcing ba dang gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas sogs bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rgyas pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// smras pa/ rgyun chags grub pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha' yi// bde chen snying po len 'dzin thar pa che'i// grong khyer mchog tu skal bzang sku bzhi dang*// ye shes lnga ldan smin par byed pa'i thabs// bzang ngan stong gzugs ston pa'i me long khyod// dbang po 'bring rtul 'jug yul cho ga yi// sgrun zla nga la yod snyam rgyags mi 'tshal// dgongs 'grel mkhas pa'i blos kyang 'gran gyis dogs// zab yangs ge sar 'dab ma rab rdzogs kyang*// rgyas min ngag gi rgya nang chud pa de// dpyad gsum dga' ma'i kha chang gis phye ba// rgyal bstan ral par mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur cig /ces bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor dbang chog ba ku la'i kha 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni/

grub chen sa ra ha'i mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung dang*/ nā lend+ra'i mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog gnyis ka'i rjod byed bsdus che bar bstan/ de dag ches gsal ba zhig dgos zhes mdo sngags rab 'byams smra ba'i chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ rmor chen pa'i legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i skal ba sbom por gyur pa'i gsang sngags 'dzin pa bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung me zla'i dga' ba zhes pa chu 'brug gi bgrang gzhi'i zhag mdzod rgyu skar bu mo tha skar gyi nya ba'i tshes dge bar dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab chen por bris pa sarba satwāṃ hi ta bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
